Commanding Shout: Dispels all debuffs from the ally and grants immunity and a barrier (proportional to the caster’s max Health) for 2 turns.

S3.name: All-Out Attack
S3.description: Attacks all enemies again after a swordstorm, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns, and increases Defense of all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Shield Thrust
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword and shield, with a 50% chance each to dispel one buff twice. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Escort
S2.description: At the start of battle and at the end of the caster's turn, grants escort to the caster for 1 turn. After an ally except for the caster is attacked by a Single Attack, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 7%.

S3.name: Judgment of Light
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a shield, dispelling all buffs and a 75% chance to stun for 1 turn, before granting a barrier to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt and barrier strength increase proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Zippity Zap!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. When it is the caster's turn, gains 1 Focus. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Wild Charge
S2.description: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 20%. At the start of the turn, gains 1 Focus and grants Bzzt! to the caster for 1 turn, and when Focus is full, resets cooldown of Operation: Cream Pastry.

S3.name: Operation: Cream Pastry
S3.description: Attacks the enemy using adaptable tactics, inflicting up to 25% injuries, and grants increased Speed to all allies for 2 turns. When Focus is full, consumes all to recover Health of the caster, and a successful attack will inflict additional damage equivalent to 60% of injuries inflicted on the target. Damage dealt and amount recovered increase proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Ankle Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S2.name: Blade Gust
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a blade gust, with an 80% chance to make them unable to be buffed for 2 turns. When there are three or fewer enemies, damage dealt increases with fewer enemies.

S3.name: Gliding Slash
S3.description: Attacks the enemy repeatedly, granting increased Attack and Weakness Shared to the caster for 2 turns, before absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health. A critical hit has a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S1.name: Rapid Fire
S1.description: Attack the enemy by shooting, and increases Combat Readiness of the ally with the highest Combat Readiness except for the caster by 10%. At the end of the turn detonates bomb effects inflicted on the target.

S2.name: Vampire Hunter
S2.description: At the start of the turn, dispels immortality from all enemies. Ignores Effect Resistance. At the end of someone's turn, when an enemy has immortality, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 35%.

S3.name: Chain Explosion
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, dispelling two buffs before inflicting decreased Defense and bomb for 2 turns. A critical hit will grant an extra turn.

S1.name: Hilag's Pride
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a lance, with a 35% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Maelstrom Waltz
S2.description: Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines, and grants counterattack to the caster for 3 turns.

S3.name: Promised Glory
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by rushing them down, and grants immunity to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S1.name: Quick Fire
S1.description: Rapidly shoots the enemy, with a 35% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Precise Attack
S2.description: Fires a missile at the enemy, and when the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction. Hit Chance is increased by 15% when using this skill.

S3.name: Limiter Release
S3.description: Releases the limiter, granting increased Attack (Greater) and Critical Hit Chance to the caster for 2 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S1.name: Sweep
S1.description: Rapidly attacks two enemies with a swordstorm. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S2.name: Dancing Blade
S2.description: When an enemy dies, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. When an enemy is defeated by Sweep or Blade Ascent, grants increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns and activates Dancing Blade. Dancing Blade (gains 1 Soul): Attacks all enemies with a sword blast.

S3.name: Blade Ascent
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a swordstorm, dealing damage proportional to the caster's Speed.

S1.name: Graceful Cut
S1.description: Attacks with a sword, with a 65% chance to decrease Attack for 1 turn. When it is not the caster's turn, increases Combat Readiness by 15% and gains double the amount of Focus.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100% and decreases Attack of the target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Duel Accepted
S2.description: As preparation for a duel, dispels two debuffs from the caster and grants perception for 3 turns, before recovering 15% Health. Grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Butterfly Cut
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by piercing them with a sword before consuming all Focus. Damage dealt increases proportional to the amount of Focus consumed, and when consumed Focus is 5, resets the cooldown of Butterfly Cut. When Butterfly Cut is not on cooldown, increases Evasion by 35%, and when evading, counterattacks with Graceful Cut.

S1.name: Vitality Drain
S1.description: Smashes the enemy with a rock, increasing the caster's Combat Readiness by 10%. A critical hit will increase the caster's Combat Readiness by an additional 10%.

S2.name: Thunder God's Cry
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a thunderstorm. When an enemy is defeated, activates Thunder God's Cry once more. Each subsequent Thunder God's Cry activated this way deals decreased damage, and can be activated up to 3 times.

S3.name: Mana Amplification
S3.description: Fully amplifies mana, granting immunity to all allies for 3 turns before granting increased Attack (Greater) to the caster for 3 turns while increasing Attack of all allies except for the caster for 3 turns.

S1.name: Weak Point
S1.description: Shoots an arrow at the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by 10%. When the enemy is targeted, increases damage dealt.

S2.name: Steady Aim
S2.description: Has a 80% chance to target a random enemy for 2 turns at the beginning of each turn.

S3.name: Fatal Shot
S3.description: Attacks the enemy's vital points, with a 80% chance to stun for 2 turn.

S1.name: Basic Shot
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by shooting arrows, with a 40% chance to target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Concentrated Fire
S2.description: Fires arrows at the enemy to attack, dispelling one buff. When the caster has a buff, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S3.name: Shock Arrow
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by shooting lightning arrows, inflicting silence and decreased Attack for 2 turns and decreasing Combat Readiness by 100%. Grants a barrier (proportional to the caster's level) to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Spiral Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a machete, with a 65% chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100%, and decreases Defense of the target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Natural Storyteller
S2.description: After an ally uses an attack that targets all enemies, activates Continuous Strike against the enemy with the highest Combat Readiness. Continuous Strike: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by 20%, and increases Combat Readiness of the ally with the highest Combat Readiness except for the caster by 20%.

S3.name: Narrative Retcon
S3.description: Plants a bomb on all enemies and decreases Speed for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the target.

S1.name: Sniper
S1.description: Shoots the enemy with a rifle, with a 35% chance to target them for 2 turns.

S2.name: Quickfire
S2.description: Shoots all enemies with a rifle, with a 75% chance to dispel one buff, and increases Speed of the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Finishing Shot
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a mana bullet. Penetrates the target’s Defense. Increases Hit Chance by 50% when using this skill.
S3.soulburn_effect: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

S1.name: Overpower
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a 85% chance to inflict burn for 1 turn. When Merciless Execution is on cooldown, activates Annihilate instead of Overpower. Annihilate: Attacks the enemy, inflicting burn for 1 turn, and at the end of the turn, detonates burn effects inflicted on the target.
S1.soulburn_effect: Inflicts an additional burn effect for 1 turn.

S2.name: Operational Readiness
S2.description: Increases Effectiveness by 20%. When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow. At the start of the first battle, grants explosives to the ally in the back row except for the caster.

S3.name: Merciless Execution
S3.description: Attacks all enemies, with a 75% chance each to inflict two burn effects for 2 turns, and at the end of the turn, detonates burn effects and bombs inflicted on the target.

S1.name: Mirror Fragment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a mirror, with a 75% chance to inflict a random debuff for 1 turn. When Mirror of the Abyss is on cooldown, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S2.name: Consuming Grasp
S2.description: After inflicting rupture on all enemies for 2 turns, attacks all enemies and has a 75% chance to inflict restrict for 2 turns. Grants stealth and a barrier (proportional to the Level) to the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Mirror of the Abyss
S3.description: Traps all enemies in a timeless space beyond the mirror, dispelling two buffs before inflicting block for 2 turns and a random debuff for 1 turn. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%.

S1.name: Hide in the Shadows
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by swinging a sword, and has a 75% chance to grant stealth to the caster for 1 turn.

S2.name: Aegis of Time
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants increased Critical Hit Resistance to all allies for 2 turns. Upon dying, revives with 30% Health.

S3.name: Once-in-a-Life Research
S3.description: (Before Enhancement) Dispels all debuffs from all allies except for the caster and recovers Health before granting barrier for 2 turns. Amount recovered and barrier strength increase proportional to the caster's max Health. Grants solution to the caster and decreases skill cooldowns by 2 turns. (After Enhancement) Grants time reversal to all allies except for the caster and grants a barrier proportional to the caster's max Health to all allies except for the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Lunging Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a 65% chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn. When used on the caster's turn, activate Dazzling Slash as an extra attack if the caster is buffed. Dazzling Slash: Swiftly attacks the enemy, inflicting restrict for 1 turn.

S2.name: Assault Coordination
S2.description: After attacking four times, grants a barrier to all allies for 2 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 15%. Barrier strength increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S3.name: Battle Cry
S3.description: Raises the morale of all allies, granting increased Attack and immunity for 2 turns and decreasing debuff durations by 1 turn.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Oopsie!
S1.description: Accidentally spills bread to attack the enemy, and triggers a Dual Attack from a random ally, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 10%.
S1.soulburn_effect: Combat Readiness increase effect will be applied to all allies.

S2.name: No Bullying!
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains 30 Fighting Spirit, and when the foremost ally except for the caster is an Earth elemental Hero, gains 40 additional Fighting Spirit, before granting Special Friendship to the target. After being attacked, gains 20 Fighting Spirit and when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all to dispel all debuffs from the caster before activating Help! Help!: Attacks all enemies, and grants an extra turn to the caster. A successful attack deals additional damage equivalent to 15% of max Health of the caster and the foremost ally except for the caster.

S3.name: Snack Time!
S3.description: Stops fighting and takes a break, dispelling all debuffs from all allies and granting continuous healing for 2 turns before increasing Combat Readiness by 15%.

S1.name: Double Slash
S1.description: Attacks by swinging their weapon, with a 35% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Dragon's Roar
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a dragon howl, dispelling one buff, before a 60% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns and a 75% chance to silence for 1 turn.

S3.name: Dragon Charge
S3.description: After granting increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns, attacks the enemy with a massive blade. When the enemy is defeated, grants an extra turn. When the target has a debuff, increases damage dealt. When this skill is not on cooldown, after an ally except for the caster uses a skill, if the enemy has a debuff, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S1.name: Cruel Touch
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a 85% chance to inflict redirected provoke for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Malicious Smile
S2.description: When attacked, reflects 40% of the damage suffered to the attacker. Reflected damage cannot be higher than the caster's max Health. After being attacked, when Health is 30% or less, dispels all debuffs from the caster and activates Murderous Intent. The effect after being attacked can only be activated once every 5 turns. Murderous Intent: Grants a barrier to the caster for 3 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 20%. Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Symphony of Agony
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by unraveling Sphere of Sadism and when the enemy is defeated, recovers the caster's Health. When the target is not an Elite or Boss monster, damage sharing effects are ignored. Penetrates the target's Defense, but cannot trigger a critical hit. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health, and amount recovered increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Homing Laser
S1.description: Attacks all enemies with a drone, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%, and increasing Combat Readiness of all allies except for the caster by 5%.

S2.name: Upgrade
S2.description: Enhances all allies with a drone, granting increased Attack and increased Speed for 3 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Meteor Cannon
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a cannon. When there are three or fewer enemies, damage dealt increases with fewer enemies.

S1.name: Vulnerability Exposed
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a longsword. Increases Hit Chance and Critical Hit Chance of this skill by 50%. When the target has a buff, increases damage dealt.

S2.name: Elaborate Plan
S2.description: Dispels two debuffs from an ally before increasing Combat Readiness of the ally by 20%. Grants increased Attack and increased Hit Chance to the caster for 3 turns. Grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Execute
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, inflicting up to 35% injuries, before granting invincibility to the caster for 1 turn. Increases Critical Hit Chance and Hit Chance of this skill by 50%.

S1.name: Vampirism
S1.description: Claws the enemy, before absorbing some of the damage as Health.

S2.name: Vengeful Strike
S2.description: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by 35% before decreasing Speed of the enemy for 2 turns and increasing Speed of the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Spiteful Annihilation
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, dispelling all buffs and making them unable to be buffed for 2 turns, before increasing Attack and Defense of the caster for 2 turns.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Black Thorn
S1.description: Attacks with thorns, with a 25% chance to stun for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Star's Armor
S2.description: When the enemy uses a non-attack skill, increases Defense of the caster and damage dealt by Ancient Beast by 7%, and increases Effectiveness by 5%. Can stack up to 8 times.

S3.name: Ancient Beast
S3.description: Summons an ancient beast to attack all enemies, with a 65% chance to inflict silence for 1 turn and bleed for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Ice Shard
S1.description: Attacks an enemy with an ice pick, with a 40% chance to decrease Speed for 2 turns.

S2.name: Ice Pick
S2.description: Attacks the enemy repeatedly, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. When the target has a debuff, increases damage dealt.

S3.name: Iceberg
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a giant iceberg, with a 50% chance to stun for 1 turn.

S1.name: Let Me Destroy You
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear, before increasing Attack of the caster for 1 turn. When the caster is deified, activates Disappear as an extra attack. Disappear can only be activated once per turn, during the caster's turn. Disappear: Attacks the enemy with a swordstorm, and when the enemy is defeated, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%.

S2.name: Supreme Authority
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, increases Combat Readiness by 20%. Unaffected by effects that reduce Combat Readiness increases the caster receives.

S3.name: Bow Down Before Me
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, dispelling two buffs before silencing for 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Grants deify to the caster for 3 turns. Penetrates the target's Defense by 100% and cannot trigger a critical hit. When the target is a Hero, damage dealt increases proportional to the target's current Health.
